battle.name: 隋梁遠擊吐谷渾之戰
battle.theater: 青海湖東南湟水洮水流域
battle.brief: 開皇三年（583）四月，吐谷渾寇隋西境，益州總管梁遠奉詔出蜀道西征，經松州北折，抵青海湖東南山谷，與吐谷渾游騎交戰。隋軍以長槊列陣、弩手外張，潰敵追奔，斬獲以千計，迫其退保湖西。此役未擒可汗、未斷商道，只壓住邊患。卡面斯巴達長矛不在此役現場，它代表長杆定陣的兵種傳統。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 這一役的交戰雙方，是中原的隋朝與控弦青海的吐谷渾汗國。隋方由益州總管梁遠領行軍總管之兵，統川軍與自秦州、隴右調來的邊軍，步騎合編，後附大批輜重與役夫；皇帝隋文帝楊堅在洛陽遙領，詔令的界線只畫在「驅敵」與「威懾」之間，並未給梁遠深入追擊或久留青海的授權。吐谷渾一方是慕容氏建立的游牧政權，名義上由可汗伏允主政，中原史籍把他的王庭記在伏俟城一線；其控制的牧地東抵洮水、湟水上游，西及柴達木與西域商道要衝，控弦之眾以數十萬計，馬群與牛羊是這個汗國立國之本。汗國沒有中原式的常備軍與城防，兵員幾乎全是可以隨時上馬的部眾騎兵，另有為商隊護航、為草場與水草爭鬥而起的輕裝游騎。兩家在體制上並不對等：一方是以郡縣、屯田、漕運為骨架的農耕帝國，一方是以部落盟誓、逐水草而居的草原聯盟，雙方在青海道這條狹窄的商路上彼此試探。
countriesEn: Two sides fought here: the Sui dynasty of China and the Tuyuhun khanate, a nomadic confederation that held the Qinghai basin. On the Sui side stood the forces commanded by Liang Yuan, who was governor-general of Yizhou in Sichuan and was given the title of commander of the expeditionary army: troops of the Sichuan border districts, contingents of cavalry drawn from Qin Prefecture and from Longyou, infantry and cavalry combined, with a long train of baggage animals and service porters behind them. Emperor Wen of Sui, ruling from Luoyang, gave his orders from a distance and drew the line of the task at repelling the raid and frightening the enemy, granting Liang Yuan neither licence for a deep pursuit nor permission to winter in Qinghai. The Tuyuhun side was a nomadic state founded by the Murong clan, nominally ruled by its khan, Fuyun, whose court and capital the Chinese histories place in the region of the Fusi city; its pastures reached from the upper Tao and Huang rivers in the east to the Qaidam basin and the caravan roads of the Western Regions in the west, with a fighting strength counted in tens of thousands of riders and, above all, vast herds of horses and cattle that formed the material base of the khanate. The khanate kept no standing army in the Chinese sense and no permanent fortifications; nearly every warrior was a tribesman who could mount at a moment's notice, supplemented by light scouting bands who rode as caravan escort or to contest pastures and water. Structurally the two were not equals: on one side an agrarian empire built on commanderies, state farms and river transport, on the other a pastoral league bound by tribal oaths and moving after the grass, the two probing each other along the narrow corridor of the Qinghai road.
people: 隋方主帥是梁遠。他出身西魏、周的邊鎮武將，隋文帝受禪後出任益州總管，坐鎮蜀中，倚著松州、茂州一線的蜀道北口，應付吐谷渾與党項的抄掠。開皇三年春，吐谷渾大舉寇邊，邊郡數告急，詔梁遠率眾西討；梁遠率輕兵先出蜀道，親率主力翻越松州高原，循山谷向北，尋吐谷渾游騎而擊。隋文帝楊堅是這一役背後的決策者：同年他正把主力放在北方對付突厥可汗，關中與洛陽可用的兵馬有限，於是對西邊只作有限度的懲罰性反擊，既不想另開一條戰線，也不容邊患坐大，這份兩難的份寸直接決定了梁遠的任務界線——打退、斬獲、劃出界線，而不是滅國。吐谷渾可汗伏允是另一端的主角，他籍著青海湖周邊的牧地與通往西域的過境財賦維持汗庭，長期游走於受封稱臣與入寇掠財之間；這一回他趁隋朝主力北上的空檔先手寇掠，梁遠的西征迫他收兵退保湖西深處。同一條戰線上接棒的是開皇四年的行軍元帥賀婁子干；而開皇初年吐谷渾曾遣太子入朝、與隋室宗女聯姻，見證了兩國往來之密，也說明此時雙方仍在羈縻與交兵之間來回擺盪。
peopleEn: The Sui commander was Liang Yuan, a frontier-company soldier who had served Western Wei and Northern Zhou, and whom Emperor Wen appointed governor-general of Yizhou when he took the throne. Seated in Sichuan, he watched the northern mouth of the Shu road around Songzhou and Maozhou and handled raids by Tuyuhun and by the Dangxiang. In the spring of 583 the Tuyuhun launched a large incursion, the border districts sent repeated appeals, and an edict ordered Liang Yuan to take troops west. He sent a light vanguard out of the Shu road first and led the main body himself over the Songzhou plateau, following the valleys northward to hunt down the Tuyuhun's roving bands. Behind the campaign stood Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian, the decision-maker: in the same year he had concentrated his main strength in the north against the Turkic khans, and the troops available at Guanzhong and Luoyang were limited, so for the west he settled for a limited punitive counterstroke, unwilling to open another front yet equally unwilling to let the border disease grow. That balancing judgement fixed the limits of Liang Yuan's mandate: repulse, seize, and mark the line, not to destroy the enemy state. On the other end of the line stood the khan Fuyun, who sustained his court on the pastures around Lake Qinghai and on the transit wealth of the road to the Western Regions, and who had long drifted between submitting to investiture and raiding for booty. This time he struck first while Sui's main army was held in the north, and Liang Yuan's march forced him to recall his riders and fall back deep beyond the lake. The man who took over the same line of country was Helou Zigan, commander-in-chief in the following year, 584; and in the early Kaihuang years the Tuyuhun had sent their crown prince to the Sui court and married him to a woman of the imperial clan, which shows how close the two states were in their dealings and how they kept sliding between tethering and fighting.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是斯巴達長矛，公元前八百年左右成形於希臘：兩米上下的木槍，槍尾包銅套，握位留出配重的餘地，希臘人用它排成密集方陣，靠前排的槍林把對手的推進擋在原地，再由後排出手分勝負。必須說明的是：這件兵器並沒有出現在公元五八三年青海的戰場上，這一役的交鋒雙方與希臘世界並無交集，卡面只是把以長杆刺擊兵器定住陣線這一兵種傳統推到眼前。隋軍在川滇高原真正使用的是槊與矛：騎兵持馬槊，兩端作刃的長杆在衝鋒時壓、挑、刺，步兵以長矛與戟列陣拒馬；輔以弓弩——臂弩、角弓與強弓，壯士佩橫刀與劍，著明光甲與札甲，戰馬披馬披、戴鍪。吐谷渾騎兵用的是可回收的短矛與骨鏃弓，配皮甲、獸皮盔與彎刀，靠馬速與箭幕拉開距離，不與隋軍槊陣正面糾纏。後勤器械上，蜀道棧道與牛車是隋軍運糧的命脈，吐谷渾一方則靠駱駝、牛羊群與驛地維持商隊通道。斯巴達長矛與隋軍的槊在技術上並無血緣，但兩者代表的那個道理相同：先用長杆把對手釘在原地，再由後排決定勝負。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Spartan dory, a form that took shape in Greece around eight hundred years before the common era: a wooden shaft about two metres long with a bronze cap at the butt and a grip left free for balance, carried by the Greeks in dense phalanxes, where the forest of points in the front rank stopped an advance in place and the rear ranks decided the contest. It must be said plainly: this weapon was not present on a battlefield in Qinghai in 583 AD, and neither side in this campaign had any contact with the Greek world; the card simply brings the tradition of the long-shafted thrusting weapon that fixes a battle line into view. What the Sui army actually used on the Sichuan-Qinghai plateau was the shao and the mao-pike: cavalry with long shao whose bladed shafts pressed, lifted and stabbed in the charge, infantry with long spears and halberds formed into pikes that checked the enemy, supported by bows and crossbows, that is arm-crossbows, composite bows and strong bows, while armed men carried sabres and swords, wore bright armour or lamellar armour, and their horses were covered in caparisons and helms. The Tuyuhun horsemen used recoverable short spears and bone-tipped bows, with leather armour, hide helms and curved sabres, relying on horse speed and a curtain of arrows to keep their distance rather than tangling with the Sui pike line. On the logistics side, the plank roads of the Shu route and ox carts were the lifeline of Sui supply, while the Tuyuhun kept their caravan road alive with camels, herds of cattle and sheep and relay stations. The dory and the Sui shao share no technical bloodline, but the principle behind them is the same: first pin the enemy in place with the long shaft, then let the rear ranks decide the outcome.
tactics: 吐谷渾的戰法決定了這場仗怎麼打。游牧政權不築城、不守塹，全軍可以在白日之內散成數千騎的遊騎：他們不與隋軍槊陣對撞，而在山谷兩側的高地、樹林與峽口居高臨下放箭，箭幕落下即退；隋軍一追，隊形便拉長，待人馬疲憊、陣形散開，敵騎再回身衝擊其側背。隋軍的應對因此是三段式：先以遊騎與前鋒騎兵搜索咬住敵騎，迫其現形並消耗其銳氣；主力以步兵長槊列為拒馬，弩手在外張弓壓射，把對手隔在一箭之外；待吐谷渾騎兵急於取勝而壓上來，才由騎兵反突，兩翼合攏斷其退路。地形是最大的變數：從益州到青海湖東南，必須翻越松州高原，谷深坡陡，道路狹窄，隊形只能單列，後隊看不見前隊的旗幟；水草有限，馬匹掉膘，人力畜力全靠後方接濟，一旦糧隊脫節，前鋒只能回捲。糧秣因此分段屯積：主力在後，騎兵自帶乾糧與數日之糧推進，戰罷即退，不作長久佔領。梁遠的處境最為尷尬——他的進攻軸線來自南方，比開皇四年賀婁子干從河西走廊西進更迂迴，也更難就地補給，只能以一次成功的野戰換取邊境安寧，卻無法把戰果變成永久的前哨。
tacticsEn: The Tuyuhun way of fighting decided how this war had to be fought. A nomadic polity raised no walls and dug no ditches, and could scatter its whole force into thousands of roving riders within a single day: instead of colliding with the Sui pike line, they shot from the heights, woods and defiles on both sides of the valleys, and withdrew as soon as the arrow curtain had fallen; when the Sui army pursued, its formation stretched out, and once the men and horses were tired and the ranks had come apart, the enemy riders turned again and struck at their flanks and rear. The Sui answer was therefore in three stages: first the scouts and the vanguard cavalry grappled with the enemy bands, forcing them to show themselves and spending their momentum; then the main body planted infantry spears as a pike fence while crossbowmen opened outward to shoot and hold the enemy beyond arrow range; and only when the Tuyuhun horsemen, impatient for a kill, rode in did the cavalry counterattack close in from both wings to cut their way of retreat. Terrain was the greatest variable: from Yizhou to the southeast of Lake Qinghai the army had to cross the Songzhou plateau, where the gorges are deep, the slopes steep and the road narrow, so the column could only march in single file and the rear could not even see the banners of the van; forage and water were limited, horses fell away in condition, men and animals depended entirely on supply from behind, and if the baggage train came apart the vanguard had to turn back. Stores were therefore staged in depth: the main body stayed rearward, the cavalry carried their own rations and several days' food forward, and once the fighting was over they withdrew rather than holding ground. Liang Yuan's position was the most awkward of all: his axis of attack came from the south, far more circuitous than Helou Zigan's advance west along the Hexi Corridor in 584, and far harder to supply in place, so all he could win was a successful field battle in exchange for quiet on the border, without any prospect of turning the victory into a permanent outpost.
data: 先把紀年與空間對齊：開皇三年即公元五八三年，是隋文帝在位的第三年，距滅陳還有六年。梁遠的出兵地在益州，即今四川成都一帶，軍隊先出松州（今四川松潘與甘肅南部相接的高原地帶），再沿白龍江、洮水、湟水各支流北折西進，終於深入今青海湖東南的牧地；這條線的直線距離在千里上下，若按山谷行軍的實際里程計算還要翻倍。戰線另一端是吐谷渾的可汗牙帳與牧場，舊史稱吐谷渾控弦之眾以數十萬計，馬群之多亦以十萬計——那是游牧政權全國可動的兵力，並非單次出戰的兵數。隋軍這邊，史料沒有留下確數，可以確定的是：主體是益州、茂州等川邊軍與關隴調來的邊騎，步騎混編，另帶大批輜重役夫，規模明顯小於開皇四年賀婁子干那次多路大舉西征；而同年三月隋軍剛在北方的白道擊敗突厥沙缽略可汗，北疆正是用兵最緊的時候，關中兵馬不能傾巢西調，這是此役規模受限的關鍵。戰果方面，舊史只留下梁遠出兵、破敵、還師一類的概括記載，並無確切的斬首與俘虜數字；有數可查的是時間：此役在開皇三四月至五月間結束，吐谷渾退回青海湖以西，兩年之後——開皇四年——才再寇涼州，隨即被賀婁子干追擊至伏俟城一線，迫得可汗請罪。
dataEn: First fix the dating and the geography: the third year of Kaihuang was 583 AD, the third year of Emperor Wen's reign, six years before the fall of Chen. Liang Yuan's assembly point was Yizhou, around present-day Chengdu in Sichuan; the army first took the road out through Songzhou, the highland on the border of today's Songpan in Sichuan and southern Gansu, and then turned north and west along the branches of the Bailong, Tao and Huang rivers, finally driving deep into the pastures southeast of Lake Qinghai. The straight-line distance on this axis is on the order of a thousand li, and the mileage actually marched through gully country is roughly double that. At the far end of the line lay the khan's tent-city and the pastures; the old histories say the Tuyuhun could put tens of thousands of riders under arms and owned horses by the hundred thousand, but that was the mobile strength of the whole nomadic state, not the number of men under arms on any one day. For the Sui side no exact figure survives in the sources; what can be established is that the core was the frontier troops of Yizhou and Maozhou in Sichuan together with cavalry transferred from Guanzhong and Longyou, infantry and cavalry combined, with a large train of baggage and porters, and that the force was clearly smaller than the multi-pronged expedition of Helou Zigan in 584. In the same month of March the Sui had beaten the Turkic khan Shibi Luo at Baidao in the north, so the northern frontier was consuming the army's attention at exactly that moment and Guanzhong troops could not be shifted wholesale westward; that is the key reason for the limited scale of this campaign. As for results, the old histories record only that Liang Yuan marched out, broke the enemy and returned, with no dependable count of the slain or captured; what can be dated is the timing: the campaign closed between the fourth and fifth months of Kaihuang, the Tuyuhun withdrew west of the lake, and two years later, in 584, they raided Liangzhou again and were chased by Helou Zigan as far as the line of the Fusi city, forcing the khan to ask for terms.
cause: 打起來有遠因也有近因。近因最直接：開皇三年春，吐谷渾看準隋朝主力正被北方的突厥牽制，率騎兵大舉寇掠隋朝西境的涼州與益州邊郡，擄走官吏與部民，奪取牲畜、糧秣與商貨，焚燒邊亭障。涼州、益州都是屯田與邊馬的產出地，一次邊郡被破的損失，遠大於一次邊軍反擊所能收回的成本，這是朝廷不能容忍的核心。遠因則是青海道的利益：吐谷渾扼住白蘭道這條絲路南道，商隊過境要繳稅、換馬、要人護衛，吐谷渾靠這筆過境財賦養活本部眾；它既然靠壟斷通道為生，就絕不會看著隋朝在青海站穩腳跟。對隋文帝來說，河西走廊背後多一個不受控的游牧政權，等於把涼州的屯田、邊馬與關中的西進通道全部暴露在對方騎兵之下。戰略上還有一層無奈：開皇年間南有陳朝、北有突厥，關中兵馬有限，朝廷既不能容忍涼州年年被掠，也不宜在統一之前耗盡主力，於是把問題壓縮成一次有計劃、有糧草上限的懲罰性遠征——出兵要快、要準、要讓可汗知道邊界在哪裡，卻不求深入滅國。梁遠此役，正是在這個框架裡的一次邊軍自衛反擊；真正改用主力大軍的，是隔年賀婁子干的西征。
causeEn: There was both an immediate cause and a deeper one. The immediate cause was plain: in the spring of 583 the Tuyuhun judged that the Sui main army was pinned in the north by the Turks, and rode in strength against the border districts of Liangzhou and Yizhou on the Sui's western frontier, taking officials and people, seizing cattle, grain and goods, and burning the border forts. Liangzhou and Yizhou produced the state farms and the remounts; the cost of one raided border district was far larger than anything a counterstroke by frontier troops could recover, and that was the heart of what the court could not tolerate. The deeper cause lay in the economics of the Qinghai road: the Tuyuhun gripped the Bailan road, the southern branch of the silk route, and caravans crossing it paid tolls, swapped horses and needed escort; the Tuyuhun lived off that transit income, and a state that made its living from strangling the corridor would never let the Sui establish a firm footing in Qinghai. For Emperor Wen, one uncontrolled nomadic power behind the Hexi Corridor meant the farms of Liangzhou, the remounts of the frontier and the westward road out of Guanzhong all stood exposed to enemy horsemen. There was a further strategic constraint: in the Kaihuang years the Chen court lay to the south and the Turks to the north, and Guanzhong's troops were finite. The court could not bear to see Liangzhou plundered year after year, yet could not exhaust its main army before reunifying the country, so the problem was compressed into one planned punitive expedition with a ceiling on its supply: it had to be fast, accurate, and had to make the khan understand where the border lay, but it was not meant to go deep and destroy him. Liang Yuan's campaign was a frontier counterstroke inside that framework; the use of the main army was reserved for Helou Zigan's western expedition the following year.
impact: 此役的直接影響，是把吐谷渾的寇掠壓回青海湖以西，為隋朝西境爭取到一年多的安寧，同時讓從益州西出、經松州入青海這條戰線第一次被隋軍走通並記錄下來。二十餘年後，唐太宗命李靖討吐谷渾，走的正是同一條路，只是規模大得多，目標也從驅趕變成滅國。更深一層看，五八三年的西征說明：只要隋朝肯把河西與川邊的資源集中起來，游牧汗國在青海就守不住既有的優勢；這既逼得吐谷渾往湖西深處收縮，也逼得它更緊地抱團。開皇四年賀婁子干多路大軍追擊、迫其請罪，吐谷渾隨後重新入朝受封，隋唐之間在青海形成打一下、羈縻一下的長期格局，而不是一勞永逸的解決。放到更長的歷史裡看，隋朝此役還開了一個壞頭：大業四年煬帝以百餘萬眾親征青海、克曼頭與赤水二城、置鄯善且末西海河源四郡，府庫為之一空，此後連年三征高句麗，隋室在十餘年後覆亡；此役之後落下的西域經營包袱，隋唐背了半個多世紀，直到唐高宗咸亨年間仍在青藏高原上與吐谷渾、吐蕃角力，663年吐谷渾終為吐蕃所滅。武器層面上，隋軍的長槊拒馬與以長杆壓住騎兵的戰法被唐軍全盤承接，成為唐蕃戰線上最主要的近戰手段。
impactEn: The direct effect of the campaign was to push the Tuyuhun's raids back west of Lake Qinghai and give the Sui western frontier a year or more of quiet; at the same time it was the first time a Sui army had marched the axis of Yizhou, out through Songzhou and into Qinghai, and that route was written down. A little over two decades later Emperor Taizong of Tang sent Li Jing against the Tuyuhun and the army took the very same road, only vastly larger and with extermination rather than expulsion as its aim. At a deeper level the expedition of 583 showed that once the Sui concentrated the resources of the Hexi Corridor and the Sichuan border, the nomadic khanate could not hold its existing advantage in Qinghai; this pushed the Tuyuhun deeper west of the lake, and equally pushed it to close ranks more tightly. In 584 the multi-pronged expedition of Helou Zigan drove them to ask for terms, and the Tuyuhun afterwards returned to court to receive investiture, so that between Sui and Tang a long pattern was set in Qinghai of a blow followed by a re-tethering, rather than any lasting solution. Seen on a longer span, the campaign also opened a bad precedent: in 610 the Yangdi Emperor led more than a million men into Qinghai, took the two cities of Mantou and Chishui and established the four commanderies of Shanshan, Qiemo, Xihai and Heyuan, emptying the treasury, and then campaigned against Goguryeo year after year until the Sui fell a little over a decade later. The burden of running the Western Regions picked up after this campaign weighed on both Sui and Tang for half a century, and the rivalry with the Tuyuhun and the Tibetans on the Tibetan plateau continued into the Xianheng era of Emperor Gaozong; in 663 the Tuyuhun state was finally destroyed by the Tibetans. At the level of weapons, the Sui pike fence and the doctrine of pinning cavalry with the long shaft were taken over wholesale by the Tang and became the principal close-combat method on the Tang-Tibetan front.
result: 打完的結果，是一場沒有定論的勝利。隋軍沒有擒住可汗，沒有解散吐谷渾的部眾，也沒有在西邊留下任何永久性的郡縣與屯田；吐谷渾退回青海湖及其以西的牧地，勢力完整地保住了。梁遠帶著部隊退回益州，軍隊沒有在青海過冬——高海拔的嚴寒、草場不足與水源有限，使任何長時間的駐紮都難以負擔，這一點決定了此役只能是打了就走的打法。從軍事效果看，梁遠做到了朝廷交辦的事：邊境不再被寇掠，被劫走的物資與人口無法完全追回，吐谷渾的游騎在兩年內沒有再深入涼州與益州。從戰略效果看，此役沒有解決問題，只是把問題推後並且推大了：開皇四年吐谷渾再寇涼州時，隋廷不再容忍，終於以賀婁子干為行軍元帥、多路大軍直搗伏俟城一線，迫使可汗請罪，重新入朝，恢復封號。可以說，五八三年的梁遠之役是隋朝在青海道上的第一記試探，五八四年的賀婁子干才是真正改變力量對比的一擊；此役留下的最大遺產，是一條被走通的進軍路線，和一套在高原上對付游牧騎兵的戰術雛形。
resultEn: The outcome was a victory without a verdict. The Sui army took neither the khan alive nor scattered the Tuyuhun's people, and left behind no permanent commanderies or state farms in the west; the Tuyuhun fell back to the pastures of Lake Qinghai and the country beyond it, and came away with its strength intact. Liang Yuan led his troops back to Yizhou, and the army did not winter in Qinghai: the cold at that altitude, the shortage of pasture and of water made any long occupation unaffordable, and that fact fixed the character of the campaign as a fight and a withdrawal. Judged by immediate military effect, Liang Yuan did what the court had ordered: the border was no longer being plundered, the goods and people taken could not all be recovered, and the Tuyuhun's roving bands did not penetrate as far as Liangzhou and Yizhou again for two years. Judged by strategic effect, the campaign solved nothing; it only postponed the problem and enlarged it. When the Tuyuhun raided Liangzhou again in 584, the Sui court stopped tolerating it and finally named Helou Zigan commander-in-chief of several columns driving straight for the Fusi city, forcing the khan to ask for terms, return to court and be restored to his title. The campaign of 583 under Liang Yuan was, in that sense, the Sui state's first probe along the Qinghai road; the year 584 and Helou Zigan were the blow that truly changed the balance of power. The greatest inheritance of this engagement was a line of march that had been opened and proven, and an embryonic doctrine for fighting nomadic cavalry on the plateau.
